'''2000 Tulsa Grand Slam''' was the Star Wars CCG constructed event of a Grand Slam 2000 weekend, one of 31 Decipher special tournament weekends in 2000. The winner received a complete set of uncut sheets.<ref name="gs00">[http://www.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Grand Slam 2000], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010716001210/http://bbs.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="gs00cal">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/grandslam/index.html Grand Slam calendar], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010311080940/http://calder.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/grandslam/index.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Grand Slam (constructed)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 29 April 2000<ref name="tr-d656" />
* '''Site:''' Tulsa, Oklahoma

== Decklists ==
Players posted these lists on DeckTech as decks they played at the event; the posted list may differ slightly from the one played.

* [[2000 Texas State Championship Matt Lush Matt s Old-Skool Hunt Down]] ([[Matt Lush]], [[Dark]]; 3–0) — filed under the 2000 Texas State Championship; the post says "This deck went 3-0 in both the Tulsa GS and the Texas State Championships"
